title: a pencil
summary: Hover to take it apart: a graphite core between two cedar slats, a ferrule and an eraser.

title: a language model
summary: A next-word bench: a read head takes in the sentence, the layers light up one after another, pistons lift the candidates to their odds, and a pin draws the next word.

title: a hydraulic hose
summary: Take it apart layer by layer: a rubber tube, two steel braids and a cover, crimped into a fitting. Pump it to 27.5 MPa.

title: Chinese fried rice
summary: Light the burner and cook it step by step: egg into hot oil, day-old rice, soy and scallion, then toss over the flame.

title: a RAG pipeline
summary: Step through a card-file bench: documents cut into chunks and filed once, then each question scored against every card and the top k sent to the model.

title: a tool-call guardrail
summary: Feed tool calls through a go/no-go gauge: a bad one is stamped with its validation error and sent back to the model, up to max_retries.

title: a push notification
summary: Follow a notification from a background job to a phone banner, then open one of four switches and compare what the backend and the phone report.
